title: Block composition and powers of rational Weil point returns
statement:
Fix $k_0=\mathbf F_q$, an algebraic closure $k$, a prime $\ell\ne\operatorname{char}k_0$, an algebraic closure $\Qlb/\mathbf Q_\ell$, and a finite coefficient field $E\subset\Qlb$. Let $Y_0$ be a separated finite-type $k_0$-scheme, put $Y=Y_0\times_{k_0}k$ and $s=\operatorname{Spec}k$, and let $g_Y,g_s$ be geometric Frobenius [def-weil-frobenius-detailed]. Let $d\geq1$ and $\bar x:s\to Y$ satisfy $g_Y^d\bar x=\bar xg_s^d$. Work in the framework rationalized constructible category with pullback [def-weil-derived-pullback-tensor-hom], point fibres [def-weil-finite-coefficient-point], and the specified rationalized associative composition comparisons [lem-trf-integral-pullback-comparison-realization]. Put $G=Lg_Y^*$ and $J=\operatorname{Fib}_{s,E}L\bar x^*$. For $r\geq1$ write $t_{rd,N}:JN\to JG^{rd}N$ for the $rd$ successive normalized point transports using the indicated return equality [lem-trf-local-frobenius-transport-normalization].

For every $N\in D^b_c(Y,E)$ and $r\geq1$, after the specified associative composition identifications,
$$t_{(r+1)d,N}=t_{d,G^{rd}N}\,t_{rd,N}.$$
For every $E$-Weil complex $(M,\theta)$ [def-weil-weil-sheaf-complex], let $\theta^{[j]}:G^jM\xrightarrow{\sim}M$ be its iterates and $R_j=J(\theta^{[j]})t_{j,M}$ for positive multiples $j$ of $d$ [def-weil-local-frobenius-trace]. These endomorphisms in $D^b_{\mathrm{fd}}(E)$ satisfy
$$R_{(r+1)d}=R_dR_{rd}\quad(r\geq1),\qquad R_{ed}=R_d^{\,e}\quad(e\geq1).$$
If $\bar x$ lies over a closed point $x\in Y_0$ of degree $d=[\kappa(x):k_0]$, then $R_d$ induces the specified geometric local Frobenius $F_x$ on every cohomology group.
No integral Weil-stable lattice or finite Tor-amplitude of finite reductions is required.

proof.text: Write $P=L\bar x^*$, $U=Lg_s^*$ and $H=\operatorname{Fib}_{s,E}$, so $J=HP$. The return equality holds at every positive multiple of $d$: if it holds at $b=rd$, then $g_Y^{b+d}\bar x=g_Y^d(\bar xg_s^b)=\bar xg_s^{d+b}$. For each such $j$ take the specified comparison $v_{j,N}:U^jPN\xrightarrow{\sim}PG^jN$. By [lem-trf-iterated-return-transport-scalar-calculus] at $\Lambda=E$, the maps in the question are $t_{j,N}=H(v_{j,N})I^{(j)}_{PN}$, and $I^{(j)}$ and $t_j$ are natural in every morphism, including rational morphisms. This lemma assumes precisely a geometric point and the return equality; it does not require an integral Weil structure.

source.place: Step 2: pullback raises local Frobenius to the residue-extension power; explicit rational return calculation.

proof.text:
Fix $a=d$ and $b=rd$. The specified associative, unital composition maps, respecting equality of scheme morphisms and arbitrary finite iterations [lem-trf-integral-pullback-comparison-realization], give
$$v_{a+b,N}=v_{a,G^bN}\circ U^a(v_{b,N}).$$
Indeed the first return comparison replaces $U^aU^bP$ by $U^aPG^b$, and the second replaces this by $PG^aG^b$. Both this pasted comparison and $v_{a+b}$ are obtained by splitting the same equality $g_Y^{a+b}\bar x=\bar xg_s^{a+b}$ into the two displayed return equalities; associativity is exactly the equality of these composites. All displayed functor powers are identified using these specified maps. Separately, expanding the recursion $I^{(j+1)}_A=\iota_{U^jA}I^{(j)}_A$ gives
$$I^{(a+b)}_A=I^{(a)}_{U^bA}\circ I^{(b)}_A:$$
the right side is the consecutive list of transports at $A,U A,\ldots,U^{b-1}A,U^bA,\ldots,U^{a+b-1}A$, with the same order as the left side. This is just reassociation of a finite composite, not an additional comparison theorem.

source.place: Step 2: pullback raises local Frobenius to the residue-extension power; explicit rational return calculation.

proof.text:
Apply the naturality of $I^{(a)}$ in [lem-trf-iterated-return-transport-scalar-calculus] to the point-category isomorphism $v_{b,N}:U^bPN\to PG^bN$. Substituting Step 2 and functoriality of $H$ gives
$$\begin{aligned}
t_{a+b,N}&=H(v_{a,G^bN})H(U^a(v_{b,N}))I^{(a)}_{U^bPN}I^{(b)}_{PN}\\
&=H(v_{a,G^bN})I^{(a)}_{PG^bN}H(v_{b,N})I^{(b)}_{PN}\\
&=t_{a,G^bN}t_{b,N}.
\end{aligned}$$
This proves the first clause for every $N$; only naturality is substituted into the four-factor composite.

source.place: Step 2: pullback raises local Frobenius to the residue-extension power; explicit rational return calculation.

proof.text:
Temporarily put $\theta^{[0]}=1_M$. The recursion in [def-weil-local-frobenius-trace] implies $\theta^{[a+b]}=\theta^{[a]}G^a(\theta^{[b]})$: for fixed $a$, the case $b=0$ is the identity law, and replacing $b$ by $b+1$ appends $G^{a+b}\theta$ on both sides, since $G^a$ preserves composition. Use the naturality of $t_a$ from [lem-trf-iterated-return-transport-scalar-calculus] for the rational arrow $\theta^{[b]}:G^bM\to M$:
$$t_{a,M}J(\theta^{[b]})=J(G^a\theta^{[b]})t_{a,G^bM}.$$
Thus, for $a=d,b=rd$, Step 3 gives
$$\begin{aligned}
R_dR_{rd}&=J(\theta^{[d]})t_{d,M}J(\theta^{[rd]})t_{rd,M}\\
&=J(\theta^{[d]}G^d\theta^{[rd]})t_{d,G^{rd}M}t_{rd,M}=R_{(r+1)d}.
\end{aligned}$$
Induct on $e\geq1$: the base is $R_d=R_d^1$; the recurrence gives $R_{(e+1)d}=R_dR_{ed}=R_dR_d^e=R_d^{e+1}$. These calculations take place in the endomorphism monoid of $JM$, with composition in the displayed order.

source.place: Step 2: pullback raises local Frobenius to the residue-extension power; explicit rational return calculation.

proof.text: When $\bar x$ lies above the closed point of degree $d$, the definition [def-weil-local-frobenius-trace] uses precisely $I^{(d)}_{PM}$, the return-square comparison $v_{d,M}$ and $J(\theta^{[d]})$. Their composite is $R_d$ by Step 1, so its induced map on every $\mathrm H^j(JM)$ is the specified $F_x$. The argument throughout is in the rationalized categories and uses the rational naturality and associative comparisons already asserted by the cited nodes. It never chooses a lattice stable under $\theta$ and never applies a theorem requiring finite Tor-amplitude of reductions.
